page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 15.0 GB of system memory. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, this instance allocates 7.5 GB of RAM per virtual core, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes.

The instance offers a cost-effective entry point for workloads requiring a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity without the overhead of higher vCPU counts. Because there is no local NVMe storage or integrated GPU hardware, users must factor in the latency and cost of network-attached storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, though the low core count limits parallel processing capabilities.

This server configuration is suitable for small-scale databases, caching layers, memory-intensive web applications, and lightweight enterprise applications that require more memory than standard general-purpose instances but do not demand high multi-core compute performance.
